concept.title: Check access and language before going
concept.shortdesc: As a parent with a pram who speaks Punjabi, I need to know whether a group is pram-accessible and has support in my language, so that I do not make a wasted trip.

conbody.note: Draft need (N-002). The needs catalogue is a model's draft from persona use cases and has not been agreed with stakeholders; the category links are proposals and are not confirmed.

section.title: The need
section.p: Who: parents, people who do not speak English as a first language, people with access needs.
Situation: Following up on a specific group; the answer decides whether she goes.
A good result: A clear yes, no or unknown for access and language, with how to check, and an honest statement when the feed does not record it.
How much it matters: Convenience: a miss is an inconvenience, so the bar is lower.

ul.li: Is the Family Hub one accessible by pram? And do they have anything in Punjabi?
step free access for a buggy
is there an interpreter or a Punjabi speaking session

section.title: Categories that should answer it
section.p: No category yet answers this need. That is a finding: the discovered categories do not cover it.
